technical_data.wire_transfer_verification_policy: Finance team confirmed no multi-factor verification was enforced for transfers under $500,000, allowing single-email authorization.

indicators: SPF fail for exarnple.com email domain
DKIM signature verification failure
DMARC policy set to 'none' with no enforcement
Suspicious sending IP 192.168.100.120 not matching corporate authorized IP ranges
Unusual login location IP 203.0.113.45 for CFO account
Sender domain closely resembles legitimate domain (exarnple.com vs example.com)
Wire transfer request without secondary approval or out-of-band validation
examples.detection_method: Monitor SPF/DKIM/DMARC failures with alerting on high-risk executive account emails; correlate with login anomaly detection for unusual IPs; enforce multi-factor verification and out-of-band confirmation for wire transfer requests exceeding threshold; employ domain similarity detection (typosquatting) tools to flag suspicious sender domains.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1598.002 - Phishing for Information: Spearphishing via Service

examples.detection_method: Implement strict SPF and DMARC enforcement rejecting or quarantining emails failing authentication; monitor for newly registered domains similar to corporate domains; use fuzzy matching on sender domains; enforce multi-factor verification for invoice payments; log and alert on email gateway acceptance of messages with SPF/DMARC failures from lookalike domains.
